title: Server-wide shared AI provider: workspaces without a key fall back to the operator's Anthropic-compatible endpoint
interface: Goal: in open-access mode every guest workspace has no AI key, so every AI feature fails with 'No AI API key configured'. The owner wants the server to fall back to their own Anthropic-compatible endpoint (LLMsRelay) configured only through env vars: CUSTOM_AI_BASE_URL (e.g. https://api.llmsrelay.com), CUSTOM_AI_API_KEY, optional CUSTOM_AI_MODEL (default 'claude-sonnet-4.6') and CUSTOM_AI_FAST_MODEL (default 'claude-haiku-4.5'). Read lib/ai/custom-provider.ts, lib/ai/provider-resolver.ts, lib/ai/client.ts, app/api/ai/chat/route.ts and lib/lead-finder/ai-provider.ts fully before changing anything. Rules (test-first in tests/ai-provider-resolver.test.ts): (1) ResolvedAIProvider gains source: 'org' | 'env' (set on every return) and, for the env custom case, model and fastModel. (2) envCredential('custom') returns { apiKey: CUSTOM_AI_API_KEY, baseURL: normalizeCustomBaseUrl(CUSTOM_AI_BASE_URL) } only when both env vars are set and the URL normalizes (catch and treat as unset otherwise). The env custom credential is tried LAST: after every org credential and after every other env credential (so a later ANTHROPIC_API_KEY wins). (3) SECURITY INVARIANT: the env key is only ever sent to the env base URL, and an org's custom_base_url / custom_model / custom_fast_model are never combined with the env key. In particular an org with ai_provider='custom' and a URL but no usable sealed key must resolve to the env fallback with the ENV URL and ENV models (or to another credential), never the org URL. Add tests for exactly this, plus: org custom key still beats env; env custom ignored when either var is missing or the URL is invalid (http, port, query); explicit ai_provider other providers unchanged. (4) Every consumer must use the resolved baseURL / apiKey and, for source 'env' custom, the resolved model/fastModel instead of the settings' custom_* fields: lib/ai/client.ts (getAIClient, getProviderChain, callAIWithFallback, createAIMessagesClient, model id conversion), the chat route's streaming custom branch, and the Lead Finder provider's custom branch (including its pricing lookup). Keep using createCustomFetch (SSRF-pinned) for the env URL too. (5) Change the user-facing error in lib/ai/client.ts (currently 'No AI API key configured. Add one in Settings > AI or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in environment.') to: "AI isn't set up for this workspace yet. Add a provider in Settings → AI Assistant." (no env var names in user-facing text). (6) Document the four CUSTOM_AI_* variables in .env.example under the AI providers section with empty values and a comment that this is the server-wide fallback used when a workspace has no key of its own. No database changes. Keep existing exports and behaviour for every other provider.

title: Shared AI key spending limits (per workspace and site-wide, per UTC day)
interface: Context: X1 added a server-wide fallback (ResolvedAIProvider.source === 'env') so any visitor's AI use is billed to the owner's key. Per-org token limits in ai_settings only update when an ai_settings row exists, which guest workspaces don't have, so nothing caps shared-key spend. Every call is logged to ai_usage_log (organization_id, total_tokens, created_at, metadata jsonb) by the usage logger in lib/ai/client.ts; read it and check how the chat route and Lead Finder record usage (Lead Finder may log elsewhere, e.g. lf_llm_costs; read it). Implement: (1) when a call uses an env (shared) credential, the usage log row's metadata includes shared_key: true (chat route and Lead Finder included; if Lead Finder logs to a different table, record shared usage in ai_usage_log too or count that table — choose the simplest correct option and explain it). (2) lib/ai/shared-budget-core.ts (pure, test-first in tests/ai-shared-budget.test.ts): sharedBudgetDecision({ orgTokensToday, siteTokensToday, orgLimit, siteLimit }) -> { allowed: boolean; reason?: string } with user-facing reasons ('Today's AI limit for this workspace is used up. It resets at midnight UTC.' / 'AI is busy right now. Please try again later.'); parseLimit(envValue, fallback). Defaults: AI_SHARED_ORG_DAILY_TOKEN_LIMIT=50000, AI_SHARED_DAILY_TOKEN_LIMIT=1000000. (3) lib/ai/shared-budget.ts (server-only, admin client): checkSharedBudget(orgId) summing ai_usage_log.total_tokens since UTC midnight where metadata->>shared_key = 'true', for the org and site-wide (two queries, select only total_tokens; fine at this scale), returning the decision; fail CLOSED with the busy reason if the query errors. (4) Enforce it before every AI call that resolved to an env credential: in lib/ai/client.ts (the path every CRM AI feature uses, e.g. inside checkAIAccess and/or callAIWithFallback so no feature can bypass it), in the chat route before streaming (return the reason as a normal error response), and in the Lead Finder provider. Org-owned keys are never limited by this. (5) Document both limits in .env.example. No database migration. (6) Error wording follow-up from X1: lib/ai/client.ts now throws "AI isn't set up for this workspace yet. Add a provider in Settings → AI Assistant." but app/api/ai/chat/route.ts (~line 67) still returns 'No AI API key configured. Add one in Settings > AI or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.' and lib/ai/chat-error.ts detects the add-a-key case with /no ai api key/i. Make the chat route return the same new message, and make chat-error.ts recognise both the new message and the old one (test-first in tests/ai-chat-error.test.ts), so the Copilot / AI chat add-a-key prompt keeps working.

title: ICP wizard: early AI check, exact weights, labelled checkboxes, answers kept, header fits
interface: Live test of 'Create ICP with AI' (app/dashboard/icp/client.tsx wizard ~line 740-1250, server action aiGenerateICPWizard in lib/actions/ai-icp.ts ~line 403) found: (1) the AI availability check only happens after all four steps, at Generate; add an async server action getICPWizardAvailability() in lib/actions/ai-icp.ts (a 'use server' file: export only async functions) that returns { allowed: boolean; reason?: string } from checkAIAccess('icp_matching'); call it when the wizard opens and, if not allowed, show the reason plus a link 'Open AI settings' to /dashboard/settings?tab=ai instead of step 1 (no steps, Next disabled); while checking, show a small loading line. (2) weights are normalized by rounding each one, so the review step can open at 99% or 101%: new pure module lib/icp/weights.ts, test-first in tests/icp-weights.test.ts, normalizeWeights(raw: Partial<ICPWeights> | null | undefined): ICPWeights that scales to exactly 100 using largest-remainder rounding, treats missing/negative/non-finite values as 0, and returns the default { industry: 25, size: 20, revenue: 15, title: 15, geography: 15, tech: 10 } when the sum is 0; use it in aiGenerateICPWizard in place of the inline normalization (import from the plain module). (3) Save Profile is enabled even when the edited weights don't total 100: disable it unless editWeightsTotal === 100 and show the existing red total. (4) the company-size checkboxes have no accessible name (screen readers read 'on'): associate each with its label (wrap in <label> or htmlFor/id). (5) closing the dialog (Escape, backdrop, Cancel) throws away every answer: keep the answers when it is closed and reopened, and reset them only after a successful save. (6) at ~800px wide the ICP page header's buttons overlap the 'Ideal Customer Profiles' title: make the header actions wrap below the title (or shrink) without overlap, following the PageHeader pattern other pages use. No other behaviour changes.
